application_feedback.semantics: Tempo, Travel, Memory, Length, Roam, Home, Radius, Density, Root, Scale, Run, Lock, accepted waypoint fields, HOME identity, route position, and route trace are drawn from the latest accepted Core snapshot rather than raw GUI or MIDI input.

The selected waypoint and lane expose an explicitly marked draft. Encoder or GUI edits remain proposed until Capture/Replace; switching selection discards an uncommitted draft and increments a visible discard counter.

Show selected MIDI input name, endpoint-open state, receive count, ignored count, last channel/CC/value, last mapping result, accepted control epoch, route transition count, lane event counts, dropped-event count, repair count, clamp count, and latched fault state.

endpoint_device_evidence.notes: The retained topology was previously user-confirmed with another standalone, but this Murmur Map mapping, endpoint selection, reconnect behavior, physical receipt, and feedback have not been exercised. Build and simulated protocol results do not create a Murmur Map device claim.

gesture_state_machines.semantics: CC40-43 value 127 selects default waypoint A-D for editing. Value 0 is an accepted release with no second transition. Selecting another waypoint while a draft is dirty discards that draft, restores the newly selected accepted state, and increments draft_discard_count.

CC44-46 value 127 selects Anchor, Thread, or Spark within the selected waypoint. Value 0 is an accepted release with no second transition. A dirty draft is discarded under the same explicit rule as waypoint selection.

CC47 value 127 validates and transactionally copies the complete draft lane into its selected accepted waypoint at the next audio-block boundary. Value 0 does not capture twice; intermediate values fail closed. Capture with no dirty draft is accepted as a no-op and counted.

surface_assignments.buttons: CC40-43 select waypoint A-D; CC44-46 select Anchor/Thread/Spark; CC47 Capture/Replace; all momentary 127/0
surface_assignments.encoders: CC20-27 top row map Tempo, Travel, Memory, Length, Roam, Home, Radius, Density; CC28-35 bottom row map selected draft Interval, Activity, Timbre, Color, Decay, Level, Pan plus accepted global Root
